Alex K: Heads-up — while testing the node sampleapp I hit a couple of related DX bugs: SDK ignores Retry-After and token-rotation sometimes keeps using stale token -> 429/401 loops. Anyone seen this?
Jamie (DevEx): Which SDK version? do you have logs?
Alex K: v1.4.2. Logs show Retry-After: 5 but sdk retries immediately. snippet: ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: "5"
```
Sarah (Infra): We emit Retry-After as a string in some CDN responses (ugh). If SDK parser expects an int it'll treat it as falsy.
Alex K: Also noticed param drift in sampleapp: we pass `model_name` in the quickstart but the JS SDK mapper only serializes `model`. REST endpoint accepts both, SDK drops `model_name` silently -> fallback model. Tests passed locally because REST tolerated both, but SDK behavior changed.
Mike (DevEx): Two separate vectors. For Retry-After parsing we should accept numeric strings and floats. For param aliasing we need a mapping layer + tests.
Lina (Support): This caused a customer on Dedicated to bill double tokens yesterday — they were unknowingly using a larger fallback model. I filed INC-4321.
Alex K: I put a tiny repro here: https://github.com/redwood/repro-token-rotation — steps: rotate token every 60s, run sampleapp, see intermittent 401 then SDK keeps trying 2 more times with the old token. Token provider example: ```async function getToken() { return await vault.fetch('service-token'); }``` The SDK should call provider on every attempt or at least after 401.
deploy-bot: @Alex K rate-limit alert: /v1/generate 429 x15 in 3m, auto-throttle applied.
Jamie (DevEx): Proposed plan: 1) patch retry parser to accept string/float and honor seconds; 2) add serializer alias support for `model_name` -> `model` with unit tests; 3) add integration test for token rotation (simulate provider change + 401 path). I'll open PRs and tag owners. :+1:
Alex K: Thanks — can we also add a short Quickstart note about token rotation and to prefer provider functions that always fetch current token?
Mike (DevEx): Yep. I'll link INC-4321 to the SDK backlog and create the tasks. cc @Lina (Support) to keep customer updated. :facepalm:
